description: Land Acquisition - Thambagalla, Ganewatta D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired for public purposes, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Minister of Lands), the core content is about land/property matters rather than government structure or personnel changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
